To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we synthesized a novel series of isoxazoles/triazoles linked 6-Hydroxycoumaring derivatives using click chemistry approach, and evaluated their cytotoxic potential against five human cancer cell lines.
a series of novel isoxazole and 1,2,4-triazole derivatives of 6-OH-CH have been synthesized and screened for their cytotoxicity against five different human cancer cells.
a series of novel isoxazole and 1,2,4-triazole linked 6-hydoxycoumarins were synthesized by click chemistry approach and screened for in vitro cytotoxicity against a panel of human cancer cell lines.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of novel isoxazole and 1,2,4-triazole linked 6-hc and their evaluation as potent cytotoxic agent.
the synthesis of a new series of diverse 6-hydroxy-coumarin analogs and their biological evaluation as potential cytotoxic agents.
the synthesis and cytotoxic evaluation of novel isosazoles and triazole linked 6-hycroxy coumarin.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the present study has led to the identification of some potent cytotoxic agents with the IC50 value in the range of 10-15 μM against prostate and lung cancer cell lines.
the present study has resulted in the identification of novel isoxazole and 1,2,3-triazole linked 6-hc as potent anticancer agents.
the present series of 6-hydrxycoumarins derivatives have the potential for the development of new cytotoxic agents for the treatment of human cancers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the synthesized isoxazole and 1,2,3-triazole derivatives of 6-OH-coumarin are potent cytotoxic agents against human cancer cell lines.
the synthesized isoxazole and 1,2,3-triazole linked 6-hoxy coumarin derivatives showed potent cytotoxic activity against human cancer cell lines.
the synthesized derivatives of 6-OH-COUM are effective against the cancer cell lines.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the introduction of isoxazole and/or triazole ring to 6-hydroxy coumarin can improve its anticancer potential.
the introduction of isoxazole and 1,2,3-triazole moiety in 6-hydroxy coumarin resulted in potent cytotoxic agents against cancer cells.
the introduction of ortho substituted triazole or isoxazole moiety in the coumarin ring system resulted in improved cytotoxicity against cancer cell lines.
